title: Add approval, denial, suspend and recover handlers
purpose: Make TUI operator actions first-class durable AgentCore lifecycle commands with exact approval token semantics.
scope: Map typed approve command to AgentCore approve_step.
Map typed deny command to AgentCore deny_step.
Map typed suspend command to AgentCore suspend_run.
Map typed recover command to AgentCore recover_run.
Render exact token binding and failure reasons without raw secrets.
acceptance_criteria: Approval requires run id, step id, actor and exact token binding.
Mutated tool, resource or parameter hash is rejected before effect preparation.
Deny and suspend never prepare side effects.
Recover uses RunStore and AuditJournal truth, not model replay.
failure_modes: Approval command accepts partial or broad approval.
Denial still prepares a side effect.
Recovery replans from model output instead of durable state.
